title: Told early when a day is heading past its budget
summary: When the rate spent so far would carry today past its budget, you are told within the hour, not once half of it is gone.

payload.title: A day heading past its budget tells you
payload.body: Spend checks every 15 minutes. Once an hour of the day has gone, if what was spent so far would carry the day past its budget, you get a notice saying how much was spent and where the day is heading. Open Spend to see which service it is.
